proofs.text: Publish a version whose text names `designs/checkout/cart.png`, run `sync no_eval`, and verify the row lists `designs/no_eval/cart.png` and that the file at that path in the project holds the source file's bytes. Publish a version naming no design, sync again, and verify the row lists no design and that no `designs` directory exists in the project

rule_text: A sync copies every design file the source's text names into `designs/<anchor>/`, and creates no directory when the source names none

tests.body:
def test_sync_copies_the_designs_the_source_names(workspace):
    _add(workspace)
    _advance(workspace)
    row = upstream.sync(workspace.root, names=['no_eval'])['anchors'][0]
    assert row['designs'] == ['designs/no_eval/cart.png']
    copied = os.path.join(workspace.root, 'designs', 'no_eval', 'cart.png')
    with open(copied, 'r', encoding='utf-8') as handle:
        assert handle.read() == 'png'
tests.name: test_sync_copies_the_designs_the_source_names

def test_sync_leaves_designs_alone_when_the_source_names_none(workspace):
    _add(workspace)
    _advance(workspace, ANCHOR_V2.replace(
        'The mocks this anchor pins are designs/checkout/cart.png.\n', ''))
    row = upstream.sync(workspace.root, names=['no_eval'])['anchors'][0]
    assert row['designs'] == []
    assert not os.path.isdir(os.path.join(workspace.root, 'designs'))
tests.name: test_sync_leaves_designs_alone_when_the_source_names_none
